text:
incident-bot: DETECTED: sustained CUDA allocation failures in us-central-2 pool 'rt-gpu-a' (service=infer-prod). auto-pager fired (threshold: 18% allocation failures over 3m).

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC-318765 triggered for service 'rt-gpu-a' 1: paging oncall.

rachel: acked (rachel). I'm on it. seeing a sharp rise in cuda OOM errors and KVCache evictions. Bringing up logs now.

kevin: pulling logs and metrics. attaching tail: 
```
[2026-03-20T02:13:10Z] ERROR infer/runtime: cuda: allocation failed: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY (attempted 1.9 GiB)
[2026-03-20T02:13:11Z] ERROR infer/allocator: failed to reserve transient buffer: out of memory
[2026-03-20T02:13:12Z] WARN  infer/serving: kvcache: large eviction cycle (count=220)
```

deepa: quick hypothesis: a noisy tenant pushed a 120k token context intermittently, causing heavy prefetch and KV churn. I'd recommend immediate per-tenant context-rate limiting + route-level batch size cap.

rachel: agree. immediate mitigation plan: 1) reduce route batch_size to 1 for suspect route; 2) enable auto-fallback to quantized variant; 3) provision +1 spare in us-central-2; 4) cordon and drain top offenders.

kevin: applying batch cap now for route 'chat-heavy':
```
redwoodctl routes update --route chat-heavy --region us-central-2 --set max_batch_size=1 --reason "mitigate OOM surge"
```

ops-bot: Note: route update accepted, propagating to edge nodes.

rachel: enabling traffic split to fallback pool 'rt-quant' at 30% for us-central-2.
```
redwoodctl traffic shift --from rt-gpu-a --to rt-quant --percent 30 --region us-central-2
```

rachel: also creating a temporary per-tenant rate limit for tenant id: t-7289 to limit context window to 32k tokens.
```
redwoodctl tenants ratelimit set --tenant t-7289 --max_context_tokens 32768 --region us-central-2 --ttl 1h
```

kevin: scaling pool +1: provisioning node-810 expected in ~4m.
```
redwoodctl pool scale --pool rt-gpu-a --region us-central-2 --delta +1
```

pagerduty: INC-318765 acknowledged by rachel at 3187660010.

rachel: early metrics: 5xx error rate dropped from 12% -> 5% after batch cap and traffic shift. KVCache evictions down ~45%. Still seeing intermittent OOMs on gpu-44.

kevin: isolating gpu-44. grabbing kernel logs: 
```
[2026-03-20T02:16:40Z] ERROR kernel: cublas alloc failed on gpu-44
[2026-03-20T02:16:41Z] WARN  infer/runtime: fallback triggered due to OOM
```

deepa: suggest cordon + drain gpu-44 and reprovision as a different instance size; also add temporary throttle for long-context endpoints.

rachel: cordoning gpu-44 now.
```
redwoodctl node cordon gpu-44 --pool rt-gpu-a
redwoodctl node drain gpu-44 --force --wait 45s
```

kevin: drain in progress; traffic redirected off gpu-44.

ops-bot: auto-suppression: incident noise suppressed while active.

rachel: customer-impact update: about 1.8% of traffic in us-central-2 experienced 503/5xx in the last 10m. Notified support.squad and accounts for high-usage customers.

deepa: creating a short-term guardrail: if any single tenant causes >15% pool-wide OOM share, auto-fallback that tenant to quant variant immediately. I'll file a backlog ticket to make this automated.

kevin: drain finished at 3187660105; gpu-44 offline for reprovision. node-810 now provisioning.

rachel: monitoring window started. baseline error rate now ~0.9%. tail latency normalizing.

pagerduty: INC-318765 assigned to rachel for remediation and postmortem. Severity set to P1-td.

deepa: notes for postmortem: capture KVCache histograms, per-tenant context size distribution, route batching metrics, and allocator histograms. Also reproduce in staging using synthetic long-context workload.

rachel: will create incident channel #inc-318765 and collect artifacts. tagging postmortem owner: deepa.

kevin: provisioning complete: node-810 joined pool; health checks passing.

rachel: mitigation summary: batch cap applied, 30% traffic shifted to quant fallback, per-tenant rate limit for t-7289, gpu-44 drained for reprovision, +1 node added. Observed error rate and eviction counts return to baseline.

ops-bot: Reminder: create SEV ticket and link support notifications.

rachel: posting status to support: "We're mitigating a GPU memory pressure event in us-central-2; traffic split and scaling in place; affected requests are falling back to quantized model where needed. Monitoring 30m before closure." @support-squad @account-eng

pagerduty: INC-318765 status updated: mitigated (monitoring). No further escalation.

kevin: I'll follow up with a small allocator config patch to reduce prefetch window and add more conservative kvcache compaction. PR incoming.

deepa: assigning postmortem to myself; draft expected in 48h. action items: auto-tenant-fallback rule, per-route batching safeguards, and alert for single-tenant context spikes.

rachel: marking incident mitigated at 3187660200. keeping channel open for artifacts. great work team. :clap:

incident-bot: Incident thread created: #inc-318765 1. Add logs and assign postmortem owner.

[end of thread]
